name: botisland-android
description: Bot Island Android app (Capacitor shell that connects to your self-hosted island)

scripts.sync: node flags.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: node flags.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.apk:debug: node flags.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:play: node flags.mjs --play && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.bundle:play: node flags.mjs --play && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
